protocol.dynamic_int8_clean_policy: activation quantization depends on batch/chunk extent; calibrate only batch1 full prefill; independent batch3 and cache controls are explicitly outside calibrated execution envelope and may flag
protocol.fault_location: deployment service preprocessing/forward, outside unchanged TorchCallableAdapter; intentionally injected synthetic pipeline errors
protocol.graph_scope: FP32 only: actual traced/saved/reloaded CPU eager Llama graph, no cache, shape bound batch1..3/width1..96; excluded from INT8 controls
protocol.instability: any non-tie discrete change in a clean calibration is a reported failure, never silently widen tolerance
protocol.pool: the 18 unchanged confirm_pretrained_audit.py texts, context96; native-token costs include padding
protocol.scope: two-witness guarantee applies only to retained construction observations; unseen faults and clean cases are empirical; passing is not behavioral equivalence

selection.greedy: cost-per-new-witness greedy followed by exhaustive optimal pruning of its output
selection.random: 64 seeded random permutations, stop when same two-witness requirements met, then exhaustively optimally prune each prefix; retain all costs; time lower median-cost representative

protocol.serialization: FP32 save_pretrained safetensors then reload; additionally trace/save/reload a no-cache eager TorchScript graph and test as heldout clean execution; INT8 Linear state_dict torch.save then weights_only reload into independently reconstructed quantized model
protocol.status: prospective deployment extension of the published 0.9 probe pool
protocol.target_policy: each target has its own contract, baseline, tolerances and panel; no INT8 versus FP32 equivalence claim

timing.amortization: ceil(construction_seconds/(median_full_seconds-median_panel_check_seconds)); package checks include verification and comparison; no generation/training speed claim
timing.construction_cost: reference+all calibration+construction fault forwards+selection+package creation; excluded heldout/timing; include separately report load/serialization
